title: MSFS Marketplace Update: TechnoBrain Tokyo Haneda (RJTT) & New Regional Gateways!
description:
The Microsoft Flight Simulator marketplace just delivered a powerhouse lineup for flight simmers looking to refresh their international route network with brand-new handcrafted destinations and visual overhauls! Whether you are spooling up widebody heavy jetliners for a flagship long-haul arrival into Japan or navigating regional turbine routes across northwest China and South America, this week's featured arrivals bring serious depth to your simulator.

In this structured marketplace breakdown, we dive deep into today's major developer releases to see which scenery upgrades deserve a spot in your virtual flight logs:

✈️ ASIAN MEGA-HUBS & REGIONAL LINKS: We kick things off in Japan with the highly anticipated flagship release of Tokyo International Airport (RJTT / Haneda) by TechnoBrain. Serving over 91 million passengers annually as Tokyo's premier sky gateway, this high-fidelity rendition delivers custom jetways, dynamic apron lighting, custom CGL textures, tailored taxiway signage, and detailed terminal architecture built for heavy airliner operations. Next, we travel to Xinjiang in northwest China for Korla Airport (ZWKL) by MSFSceneryBuilders, featuring an authentic regional conversion layout, terminal structures, and updated aprons for domestic route expansion.

🌎 SOUTH AMERICAN REGIONAL GATEWAYS: We head across the globe to Missiones, Argentina along the Paraná River to explore Libertador General José de San Martín Airport (SARP / Posadas). Rebuilt with updated 3D terminal modeling, accurate apron layouts, custom ground markings, and dynamic night lighting, this airport opens up unique regional hops along the Argentine-Paraguayan border.

Which of these new additions are you filing a flight plan for first? Are you taking a 777 or A350 into Tokyo Haneda, or exploring regional destinations like Korla and Posadas? Let me know in the comments below!

If this structured marketplace breakdown helped you discover your next destination, make sure to hit that like button and subscribe for weekly MSFS realism, scenery, and marketplace updates!
